options.systemMessage:
=You are an assistant that operates a LINE Official Account.
- Reply to the user in Thai.
- Recipient LINE userId: {{ ($json.userId || '').trim() || 'NOT SET' }}
- Broadcasting enabled: {{ $json.allowBroadcast ? 'yes' : 'no' }}

Sending to the recipient (never pass a userId to these - they already know it):
- send_line_text: plain text.
- send_line_flex: a card. Prefer it whenever the content has structure - a price, a list, a link, an image, a button.

Other operations:
- get_profile takes a userId: use exactly the recipient userId above unless the user gives a different one. get_message_quota, get_follower_ids, get_rich_menu_list and cancel_rich_menu_default take no arguments; delete_rich_menu and set_rich_menu_default take a richMenuId from get_rich_menu_list.
- line_mcp_call: rich menu creation and broadcasts.

Rules:
- If the recipient userId is NOT SET, tell the user to fill it in the "LINE settings" node and do not send anything.
- Before sending, show the exact content and ask the user to confirm.
- A broadcast reaches every follower and cannot be recalled. Before calling it, say so and require the user to reply with the word "broadcast". If broadcasting is disabled above, tell the user to enable allowBroadcast in the "LINE settings" node instead of trying.
- Report the tool result after every call. If a tool rejects your JSON, read the error, fix the JSON and retry once.

nodes.name: LINE MCP
nodes.notes: The seven LINE MCP tools whose JSON schema has no "const" keyword, so Gemini can parse them. The other five (push_text, push_flex, both broadcasts, create_rich_menu) use z.literal -> const and are reached through the send_line_text / send_line_flex / line_mcp_call sub-workflow tools instead.

parameters.description: Send a plain text message to the LINE recipient already configured in this workflow. Input: text (the message to send, max 5000 characters). Do not pass a userId - the recipient is fixed.

value.text: ={{ $fromAI('text', 'The message text to send to the LINE user', 'string') }}

nodes.name: send_line_text
nodes.notes: userId comes from the 'LINE userId' node, not from the model.

nodes.name: LINE settings
nodes.notes: userId: the recipient (U + 32 hex chars). allowBroadcast: leave false unless you really mean to message every follower - broadcasts cannot be recalled. The agent can read these but cannot change them.

nodes.name: send_line_flex
nodes.notes: Recipient and safety switches come from the 'LINE settings' node, not from the model.

parameters.description:
Send a LINE Flex message (a card) to the recipient configured in this workflow. Use this for anything richer than plain text: product cards, receipts, menus, buttons, carousels.
Inputs:
- altText: short preview text shown in the chat list and where Flex cannot render (1-400 chars).
- contentsJson: the Flex CONTAINER as raw JSON (no markdown fence). Not the whole message - start at {"type":"bubble"} or {"type":"carousel"}.
Minimal bubble:
{"type":"bubble","body":{"type":"box","layout":"vertical","contents":[{"type":"text","text":"Hello","weight":"bold","size":"lg"},{"type":"text","text":"Details here","wrap":true}]},"footer":{"type":"box","layout":"vertical","contents":[{"type":"button","style":"primary","action":{"type":"uri","label":"Open","uri":"https://example.com"}}]}}
Rules the server enforces: header/hero/body/footer must each be a box; colors are #RRGGBB only; size is one of xxs xs sm md lg xl xxl 3xl 4xl 5xl; an action label is at most 20 chars; offsets and padding look like "10px"; a carousel holds 1-12 bubbles in its contents array. Do not pass a userId.

value.altText: ={{ $fromAI('altText', 'Short preview text for the card, 1-400 characters', 'string') }}
value.contentsJson: ={{ $fromAI('contentsJson', 'The LINE Flex container as raw JSON: a bubble or a carousel', 'string') }}

nodes.name: line_mcp_call
nodes.notes: Recipient and safety switches come from the 'LINE settings' node, not from the model.
